page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries, left column then right column. Running head at top left and top right (Hebrew "ת ת"), page number top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: etis, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. & 2. pl. m. Rad. בּוֹן, in Piel, בּוֹנֵן, & Hithp. הִתְבּוֹנֵנוּן.
תִּתְבַּלַּע absorbeatur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. בָּלַע.
תִּתְבָּר purum te exhibes, 2 Sam. 22. 27. pro תִּתְבָּרֵד, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. בָּרַד.
תִּתְגּוֹרְדִי incides te, תִּתְגּוֹרְדוּ incidetis vos, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. גָּרַד.
תִּתְנַעֵשׁ commovebitur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. נָעַשׁ.
תִּתְנֵר miscebis te, apoc. pro תִּתְנֶרָה, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. נָרָה.
תַּתָּה dedisti, 2. Sam. 22. 41. pro נְתַתָּה, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. aphær. literæ Nun & parag.
תִּתְהַדַּר honorem tibi arroges, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. הָדַר.
תִּתְהַלֵּל gloriaberis, vel tur, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. הָלַל.
תִּתְהַפַּךְ mutaberis, vel mutabitur, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. הָפַךְ.
תִּתּוֹם consumetur, Gen. 47. 18. pro תָּתוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַם.
תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ renovas, vel vat se, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָדַשׁ.
תִּתְחַטָּאוּ purgatote vos, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. חָטָא.
תִּתְחַכָּם sapiens eris, fut. Hithp. 2. sing. m. Rad. חָכַם.

page.notes: Hebrew forms in the left column (first two entries, and the vowel pointing of several forms) are small and partly blurred; the pointing may be imprecise. The "est," at the foot right is the catchword. The running head and page number are printed in Hebrew and Arabic numerals respectively.
